stage: post-hoc evidence-informed proposed rubric; user final decision pending
expert_grades: comparison/context only; not algorithm inputs; after feedback not independent validation
simple: 1-2 supported, <=3 total, count-band singletons, full-pattern by k<=8 >=.8; actual observed horizon kept

medium_process: same plus core cumulative by min(h,n-1)>=.8, h=10/12/15/18/19

difficult: n>=10, total>=10, f1>=4, late-quarter new geometry>=.15, core-tail15<.8; conditionally fragmented, never nonconvergence theorem
weak_cluster_separation: cross compatible >.5 yields separate semantic caution; no silent merging
source_window: finite historical people pool, not chronological acquisition
